### launch -dry-run
exit=Some(1)
--- stdout
--- stderr
flag provided but not defined: -dry-run
Usage: swarm-device-access launch [flags] -- [daemon flags]
  -config-dir string
    	Host directory bound read-only at /etc/swarm-device-access in the daemon. Empty = none.
  -dbus
    	Bind the host's systemd DBus socket into the daemon, enabling daemon-reload handling
  -host-docker-socket string
    	Host path of the Docker socket bound into the daemon (default "/var/run/docker.sock")
  -host-network
    	Run the daemon in the host network (needed for -metrics-addr/-debug-addr); default is no network
  -log-format string
    	Launcher log format: json, text or plain (default "text")
  -log-level string
    	Launcher log level: debug, info, warn or error (default "info")
launch: flag provided but not defined: -dry-run
#END
